detections.sql:
SELECT u.full_name 
FROM users u 
JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id 
WHERE UPPER(t.instrument) LIKE '%CRYPTO%' 
OR UPPER(t.instrument) LIKE '%FOREX%' 
AND t.created_at >= date('now', '-30 days') 
AND u.risk_level IN ('MEDIUM', 'HIGH') 
AND u.user_id IN (SELECT user_id 
                  FROM transactions 
                  GROUP BY user_id 
                  HAVING COUNT(txn_id) > 10 
                  AND COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(t.created_at)) > 10);

  COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) as total_users,

SELECT u.full_name 
FROM users u 
JOIN login_events le ON u.user_id = le.user_id 
JOIN (
  SELECT ip_address 
  FROM login_events 
  GROUP BY ip_address 
  HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN UPPER(status) LIKE '%FAILED%' THEN 1 END) > 10 
  AND created_at >= date('now', '-30 days')
) ip ON le.ip_address = ip.ip_address 
JOIN (
  SELECT user_id 
  FROM transactions 
  GROUP BY user_id 
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT country) >= 3 
  AND created_at BETWEEN date('now', '-2 hours') AND date('now')
) t ON u.user_id = t.user_id 
WHERE u.risk_level IN ('MEDIUM', 'HIGH') 
AND u.user_id NOT IN (
  SELECT user_id 
  FROM login_events 
  WHERE created_at BETWEEN date('now', '-2 hours') AND date('now')
);
